name: GetResponse
description: GetResponse is an all-in-one marketing platform combining email marketing, automation, landing pages, webinars, and SMS so businesses can manage the full customer journey from a single tool.
best_for: Positioned for entrepreneurs, e-commerce stores, and enterprise brands that want AI-assisted tools covering every step of the customer journey, from lead capture to repeat revenue.
features: Email marketing with AI-optimized send times for promotional and lifecycle emails
Marketing automation workflows including welcome sequences and cart recovery
AI-assisted landing page creation for campaigns and lead capture
SMS marketing and web push notifications
Forms and popups for lead generation
AI tools for content tailoring, copywriting, and layout selection

tiers.name: Free Plan
tiers.notes: Up to 500 contacts, 2,500 newsletters/month, and 1 website builder.

tiers.name: Email Marketing
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $15.58/mo (or $19/mo monthly) for 1,000 contacts; includes AI email generator, autoresponders, and basic landing pages.

tiers.name: Marketing Automation
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $48.38/mo (or $59/mo monthly); adds advanced event-based automations, webinars (up to 100 attendees), and contact scoring.

tiers.name: Ecommerce Marketing
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $97.58/mo (or $119/mo monthly); adds transactional emails, abandoned cart recovery, and promo codes.

pros: Comprehensive all-in-one marketing suite combining email marketing, landing pages, webinars, and conversion funnels
AI-powered email generator and auto-timing optimization to maximize recipient open rates
Native ecommerce integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce, and Stripe for automated product recommendations
cons: Advanced automation workflows, scoring, and webinar hosting require upgrading to the Marketing Automation tier
Phone customer support is restricted to enterprise Max custom plans
Pricing scales progressively with list size as subscriber counts increase

alternatives.name: Mailchimp
alternatives.description: An email and SMS marketing platform combining analytics, automations, and AI tools for integrated customer communications.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting a wide template library and app ecosystem

alternatives.name: Brevo
alternatives.description: An integrated marketing and CRM platform for email, SMS, WhatsApp, and chat campaigns.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting multi-channel messaging with a built-in CRM

alternatives.name: ActiveCampaign
alternatives.description: An autonomous marketing platform where AI agents handle email, SMS, WhatsApp, and CRM tasks backed by customer data.
alternatives.best_for: Growing businesses wanting deep automation and a CRM

alternatives.name: Zoho Campaigns
alternatives.description: An AI-powered email, SMS, and WhatsApp marketing platform with contact-tier pricing and deep integration into the wider Zoho suite.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses already using or considering the wider Zoho suite who want low-cost, contact-tiered email marketing
